title: Reverse a String
description: Write a function that takes a string and returns it reversed. For example, 'hello' should become 'olleh' and 'world' should become 'dlrow'.
instructions: Complete the reverse_string function so it returns the input string in reverse order.
hints: Think about building a new string by reading the original from back to front.
You can loop from the last index down to 0 and append each character.
The last index of a string s is s.length() - 1.
